feedback: Written before this robot has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. (1) Evidence from iteration 0 (all 60 trials off track, progress 0.105 to 0.155, max_error 0.062 to 0.069 m, 1 to 2 line-loss events) shows the baseline could not hold the tape through the first bends. To make the robot hold the line I had to lower base_speed to 1.2 and raise kp to 2.0 with kd 0.4; the signal stays within about +/-2 so this does not saturate the wheels at 0.6 kg, but it means the controller is working hard at the bends. (2) The 0.05 m sensor offset and 16 mm footprints mean the signal is less laggy than at 0.04 m, so kd is needed less for lag and more for jitter; if steering_oscillation rises with progress, that points to the speed and gain balance rather than the geometry. (3) The 0.06 m off-track floor still governs (body_width 0.12 m gives 0.0425 m), so body_width is not a lever. Change rules for the next race: if line_loss_events stays at 1 or more and max_error is still near 0.06 m, widen wheel_track to 0.15 m to add turn authority at the bends. If progress is high but completion_time is long with no losses, keep the 0.5 kg mass and raise base_speed in steps rather than changing geometry. If the outer sensors read near 1 on the tape edge (saturation), try sensor x of +/-0.020 m with 16 mm footprints to keep the signal monotonic.
requested_changes: Try wheel_track 0.15 m if the next race still shows line_loss_events of 1 or more with max_error near 0.06 m, since iteration 0 showed the robot leaving the tape on the first bends and a wider track adds turn authority (H3, untested).

Try sensor x of +/-0.020 m (outer) and +/-0.010 m (inner) with sensor_size 0.016 if the outer sensors saturate, since the 16 mm footprints at 0.024 m could read full tape early and reduce steering authority; iteration 0 showed sensor coverage was the weak point at 12 mm.

Try mass 0.45 kg if completion_time is above about 2.5 s without line losses, since iteration 0 showed the wheels were not slipping at 0.6 kg and lower mass speeds acceleration without changing the off-track limit (H4, untested).
